admission.justification: The shared body-and-citation contract is prescribed by the Curator format rules and realized by three distinct source-file, repository-overview and source-area layouts, whose explicit governing-rule pointers and Evidence tables carry the same fixer-input-to-numbered-reference boundary.

applicability: File cards and repository or source-area overviews authored or maintained by Curators in converted onboarding memory.
conditions: A numbered evidence marker has its corresponding sidecar reference; a card with no references need not have a sidecar.
Evidence tables are authoring input, and numbered evidence lines and their references are authored through the admitted citation route.
exclusions: Input ledgers and report templates that legitimately use tables but are not onboarding cards.
Setup-only Bootstrap behavior and first-baseline status/adoption; this authoring-format record grants no Bootstrap authoring authority and adds no baseline-admission rule.
This record does not override the admitted writer/tool ownership or scoped correct-write recovery.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_bootstrap_converted_onboarding.py::test_bootstrap_skill_texts_carry_no_legacy_card_format; mcp/tests/test_sync_scripts.py (72 generated copies byte-equal); evidence/run-new-module.txt (18 passed)

statement: Curator file cards and overviews hold current prose and numbered evidence lines, without metadata stamps, card-local change history or completed citation tables; the citation fixer turns the author's evidence table into those numbered lines and their JSON sidecar references.
